d: Great royal hall in the castle of Elsinora. The King, the Queen, Hamlet, Polonius, Laerte, Dames, Cortigiani, Ciamberlani, Officers, Paggi.

A platform. It is dark night: on the right the castle of Elsinora. The trees and climaxes of the castle white with snow. Hamlet, Horace, Marcello, wrapped in long coats slowly advance, poses the Ghost.
A room in the castle, the King, the Queen, Polonius, Hamlet pose.

The hall of the performances lavishly adorns, and by splendid illuminated candlesticks. In the bottom a short rial covered with rich velvets and gold in the form of a stage; no other ornament stands on it outside of a stool. Here and there in the room will be placed scans for the spectators. Pompous entrance of the Court. Enter the King, the Queen, Polonius, Laertes, Ofelia, Hamlet, Horace and Marcello.
An alcove in the castle. Brings with curtains. A kneel; various other furniture; a portrait of the King hanging on the wall. The King, poses Hamlet.

A romantic place in Elsinora Park. In the extreme bottom on the left there is a side of the castle. High spots of pine and fir scattered here and there. A stream flows through the scene to the sides of which sinuous bushes of flowers are joined. A weeping willow bathes its branches in the wave. The hour is the sunset, a warm light indours the landscape. The King followed by the Soldiers travels lost the scene, as if to seek a refuge. Laerte and Ofelia: amazed by revolt in the distance.
A cemetery. It's dark night. Two undertakers dig a grave and sing. Then Hamlet and Horace.
